description: Labeled CV classification evaluation dataset. 3 samples per category (27 total), hand-written to be representative but not exhaustive. Secondary-category ground truth is provided only where a genuine overlap is plausible (see 'secondaryCategoryNote' on those samples) - most samples have an empty secondaryCategories array, which is itself a valid ground-truth label (no secondary category applies).

samples.cvText: Maria Santos - 6 years implementing airline PSS integrations, building reservation and ticketing modules for a major GDS provider.
